place.source_title: United Methodist Church of Batavia, 8 North Batavia Avenue

brief: Massive Romanesque Revival church of 1887 built of multicoloured field boulders with cut-limestone arches and string courses: a square corner tower with a steep pyramidal roof and arcaded belfry, a deep round-arched entrance porch at its foot, and broad gabled wings under a hipped roof. Record: 1 photo plus 8 HABS measured drawing sheets.
